metadata.title: Why Is Tether Looking Like a Central Bank?<!-- --> - Barron's

content.text:
Why Is Tether Looking Like a Central Bank?
Gold’s recent rally is mostly due to five big buyers: four central banks and Tether, a company that deals in cryptocurrency.
